ocr.notes: Headline and a few words garbled.

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Democrat ran a column of jokes about the Allen-Hogan fight that never came off on Chouteau Island, noting that there was fighting at Tom Allen's benefit that night.

metadata.notes: Running head reads 'The St. Louis Democrat: St. Louis, Thursday, October 30, 1873'; masthead 'Daily Democrat'. Pre-1875 merger.

facts.fact: The Allen-Hogan fight, meant for Chouteau Island, did not take place

notes: Jokes only; Chouteau Island as the intended site is implied by a quip. The same page has an 'Allen-Hogan: The Match Off and Another Made' article not in this clipping.
